desc: Winchester is continuing a shotshell manufacturing pedigree of quality and innovation that extends back to 1886. From the 19th through the 20th, and now into the 21st century, Winchester has led the industry in ground-breaking developments in shotshell loads and components. These shotshells are designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance in sporting clays, trap and skeet - all at a highly competitive, value price. AA Super Sporting Clay Target Loads are designed for competition or recreational sport clay shooting.
